Paper: A multi-echelon split delivery vehicle routing problem
Authors: Pirkwieser, S. and Raidl, G. R.
Methodology: Two-echelon SDVRP formulation solved with VLS and ALNS metaheuristics on benchmark instances
Key finding: Combining split delivery with two echelon beats single-depot routing on large instances
Limitations: Small synthetic instances only; single product; no real cost or price data
Research gap: Real-data multi-echelon split delivery is barely tested

Authors: Crevier, F. and Cordeau, J.-F. and Laporte, G.
Methodology: MDVRP with intermediate depots; set covering formulation plus tabu search; capacity and max-transshipment constraints
Key finding: Depot capacity limits and transshipment caps change total cost significantly
Limitations: No split delivery at depots; demand known in advance; no time windows
Research gap: Relaxing full-load transfer at transshipment points
